title: A conversation with explicit turns
description: Each person ends their own sentence, then listens to the translation and the reply.

blocks.text: Automatic pause detection sometimes cuts the speaker off. A simple button can give the conversation a predictable rhythm.

quote.text: The auto-detection in Conversation Mode is too aggressive. When sharing one phone with a friend, the app constantly cuts me off and blasts out translations while I'm still talking. It causes a confusing overlap of audio that ruins the conversation. Please bring back the manual recording controls and

blocks.text: Make the recording, translating and playback states clear. Let people correct what was recognized before it is spoken.
Test two people operating one phone. The button should not require constantly watching small labels or a complicated switch between sides.
